answer_1.quote: Knowledge Editing. KE aims to transform the behavior of the original model f base into postedit model f e . Given an edit descriptor z e = (x e , r e , y e ), where (x e , r e , y e ) represents a triplet such as (US, President, Joe Biden) meaning Joe Biden is the president of US. KE ensures that f e (x e , r e ) = y e while f base (x e , r e ) ̸ = y e . A thorough edit not only modifies the corresponding knowledge but also all the knowledge within the multi-hop relations that are impacted by this edit.
answer_1.outputs: Generated answers to multi-hop questions based on edited knowledge
